progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on D in Abolchap. The line peaks at A4 (441.7 Hz) at 0:47.9. It closes on A4, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → A3 → A3 → A3 → A4).

flags: tonic D set in the catalog (Rast-Panjgah's finalis D (18 of the suite's 25 gushe-ha end there). Rast is customarily played a 5th below Mahur (Farhat 1990, p. 100), and Alizadeh's Mahur is on A. In Rast, Abolchap, Tarz and Leyli-o Majnun take the 5th as their finalis (Farhat 1990, p. 106). The vote picked that 5th (A). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 220.9 Hz (A)
